brand.name: Suryavana
brand.address: 100 Ocean Avenue, Santa Monica, CA 90401, United States

rooms.name: Deluxe Garden Room
description: Wake to birdsong and filtered green light in a room that opens straight onto our landscaped palm garden. Warm timber, linen textures and a deep soaking tub keep everything soft and unhurried.
It is the quiet heart of the resort: a few steps from the lagoon pool, yet far enough away that the only sound is the breeze.

rooms.name: Premier Ocean View
description: Folding teak doors slide away and the whole room becomes a terrace over the Arabian Sea. Linen drapes catch the morning light while the daybed is made for slow afternoons.
Evenings bring the best seat in the house: a private deck for sundowners as the sky turns copper and rose.

rooms.name: Cliffside Pool Suite
rooms.tagline: A private plunge pool above the waves
description: Stone, glass and warm wood come together in a suite built around its own plunge pool. Step outside and the cliff edge drops away to open sea.
A dedicated butler arranges everything from in-villa breakfasts to candle-lit dinners on the deck.

rooms.name: Overwater Lagoon Villa
description: Our signature villa sits on stilts above a glassy lagoon, with a thatched roof, wraparound windows and a deck that steps into the water.
Lie in bed and watch fish drift beneath the glass floor panel, then paddle out for sunrise before breakfast arrives by canoe.

rooms.name: Heritage Royal Suite
description: Velvet, brass and soft lamplight give this suite the feel of a private manor. A separate lounge makes it ideal for longer stays or celebrations.
Tall windows frame the fountain courtyard, which glows after dark and is lovely from the bath.

rooms.name: Family Residence
rooms.tagline: Space for everyone, privacy for each
description: Two bedrooms, a sunny living area and a kitchenette make this the easiest way to holiday with family. Everyone gets their own corner, and meals are never far.
Step out the door and you are beside the family pool, with the kids' club and beach path a short stroll away.

rooms.name: Botanical Forest Cottage
rooms.tagline: Nestled amid canopies and fragrant flora
description: Set deeper inside our tropical grove, the Botanical Forest Cottage offers serene seclusion beneath whispering canopies.
Wake to birdsong, unwind on a private timber deck, and enjoy organic herbal infusions gathered from our gardens.

rooms.name: Oceanfront Horizon Suite
rooms.tagline: Panoramic seascapes and open salt breezes
description: Elevated above the shoreline, floor-to-ceiling glass captures the full sweep of the Arabian Sea horizon.
Sip morning espresso on the expansive terrace while watching fishing boats head out across glassy waters.

rooms.name: Coastal Sunset Haven
rooms.tagline: Front-row vantage for golden hour colors
description: Positioned on the western shoreline, every evening paints your private balcony in radiant copper and amber tones.
An open-air stone soaking tub on the deck lets you watch twilight give way to coastal constellations.

rooms.name: Presidential Penthouse Suite
rooms.tagline: The pinnacle of elevated sanctuary living
description: Occupying the uppermost tier of the resort, this penthouse combines expansive living quarters with unmatched 360-degree vistas.
Featuring handcrafted teak furnishings, a formal dining space, and bespoke personal butler service throughout your stay.

rooms.name: Private Forest Pool Villa
description: Tucked behind lush bamboo groves, this two-bedroom villa centers around a sparkling private pool and sunken garden lounge.
Total privacy meets intuitive luxury with direct butler access, outdoor rainfall showers, and twilight poolside dining.

rooms.name: Royal Beachfront Villa
rooms.tagline: Direct sand access with private cabana deck
description: Step straight from your private lawn onto the pristine golden sands of Suryavana Beach.
Complete with a private sunset cabana, personal chef options, and dedicated electric buggy for exploring the grounds.

experiences.title: Beach Adventures
experiences.text: Kayaks, paddle boards and sunrise walks on a private shoreline.
experiences.back: Guided kayak trips, paddle-board lessons and island-hopping by boat. Equipment and instructors are included for in-house guests.

experiences.title: Pools & Cabanas
experiences.text: Three pools, sunset cabanas and a swim-up bar.
experiences.back: An adults-only infinity pool, a family lagoon pool and a kids' splash zone, with poolside service and private cabanas you can book by the day.

experiences.title: Fine Dining
experiences.text: Coastal tasting menus built from fish landed that morning.
experiences.back: Four restaurants from beach grill to a seven-course terrace tasting menu, timed to the sunset.

testimonials.name: Ananya Mehta
testimonials.quote: We came for a long weekend and left planning our return. The staff remembered our names by breakfast, and the plunge pool at sunset was unreal.

testimonials.name: James Whitfield
testimonials.quote: Waking up over clear water felt like a film set. Service was quietly perfect: never intrusive, always one step ahead.

testimonials.name: Priya & Rahul Nair
testimonials.quote: Our honeymoon was made special by little touches: flowers on the bed, a private beach dinner, and a handwritten note.

testimonials.name: Sofia Marchetti
testimonials.quote: Beautiful design and the best seafood I have had in India. The room was spotless and the breakfast on the terrace is worth the trip alone.

testimonials.name: Arjun Kapoor
testimonials.quote: Travelling with two kids is usually chaos. Here the kids' club, the pool and the space in our residence made it effortless.

testimonials.name: Hannah Becker
testimonials.quote: Peaceful, green and spotless. I did yoga at dawn, read all afternoon and ate like a queen every night.

posts.title: Hidden Coastal Beaches
posts.excerpt: Skip the crowds. Our concierge shares the quiet coves locals keep to themselves.
body: While the central shoreline draws holidaymakers for morning sunbathing, the true soul of our coastal sanctuary lies tucked behind rugged granite headlands. A short fifteen-minute stroll past ancient banyans leads to concealed coves where azure waves lap against pristine white sand in secluded serenity.

Timing is essential for coastal exploration. We recommend setting out in the tender glow of early morning when low tide reveals glistening tidal pools filled with sea anemones, polished cowrie shells, and coral formations untouched by crowds.

Our concierge curates bespoke beach exploration kits for guests. Packed with handwoven linen towels, mineral sun protection, refreshing chilled coconut water, and a gourmet picnic hamper, you are equipped for an undisturbed morning retreat.

For the ultimate private escape, charter a traditional wooden catamaran from our jetty to secluded sandbanks accessible only by water, returning just in time for an afternoon citrus infusion under our shaded cabanas.

posts.title: Designing Restful Sleep
posts.excerpt: Mattresses, blackout curtains and quiet air-conditioning: the small details behind a great stay.
body: In the realm of luxury hospitality, true indulgence begins with undisturbed, restorative rest. At Suryavana, every guest suite is an architectural study in sensory tranquility, crafted from ground up to ease the mind into effortless rejuvenation.

Acoustic architecture ensures absolute quietude. Solid reclaimed teak doors with perimeter soundproofing seals, plush underfelt carpets, and double-glazed acoustic glass buffer ambient noise, allowing only the rhythmic hush of distant waves to enter.

The centerpiece of each bedroom is our custom mattress layered with natural organic latex and breathable cotton batting, paired with 600-thread-count Egyptian cotton linens for optimal ergonomic spinal alignment throughout the night.

Ambient lighting eliminates blue light spectrums after dusk, while motorized blackout linen drapes ensure total optical darkness. Complemented by evening jasmine aromatherapy and our bespoke pillow menu, deep restorative sleep comes naturally.

posts.title: Sunset Dining Guide
posts.excerpt: Four restaurants, one golden hour. Where to sit and what to order.
body: As twilight descends over the Arabian sea, the horizon transforms into a mesmerizing canvas of burnt sienna, dusty rose, and liquid gold. At Suryavana, the evening golden hour is a cherished culinary ritual celebrated across four distinct dining venues.

For guests seeking barefoot romance, the Beach Grill offers front-row seats on the sand. Timber lantern-lit tables set directly into the shoreline allow you to feel the cool evening tides while savoring fresh catch-of-the-day grilled over coconut husks.

Higher on the cliffside, the Terrace Pavilion presents our signature seven-course tasting journey. Executed with artistic precision, each dish is synchronized with the sun's descent, transitioning from crisp sea-scallop ceviche to spiced coastal delicacies.

Conclude your evening at the sunset cabana lounge with artisanal aperitifs infused with local botanicals, listening to acoustic sitar melodies as lanterns cast shimmering reflections across the water under a canopy of stars.

posts.title: Honeymoon In Goa
posts.excerpt: Candle-lit dinners, private villas and the best months to travel.
body: A honeymoon should be an effortless sanctuary of connection, where romance unfolds naturally without rush or rigid timetables. Set amidst ancient coastal forests and turquoise lagoons, Suryavana provides the quintessential backdrop for newlyweds embarking on a lifetime together.

Our dedicated romance concierges curate personalized itineraries striking the ideal balance between enchanting experiences and quiet seclusion. We encourage couples to schedule one anchor activity per day, leaving ample unhurried hours by private infinity plunge pools.

From arrival frangipani garlands and chilled vintage champagne to floral bath rituals, every detail elevates your stay. Among our most cherished experiences is the private sandbank dinner illuminated by glowing lanterns with a personal chef and butler.

Complement your journey with dual Ayurvedic warm oil therapies at our forest spa. The optimal months span from October through April, when gentle ocean breezes and clear sapphire skies weave unforgettable magic into your celebration.

posts.title: Family Escape Guide
posts.excerpt: How to keep kids busy, grandparents comfortable and parents actually relaxed.
body: Traveling across generations requires thoughtful spaces where children find adventure, grandparents find comfort, and parents discover genuine relaxation. Suryavana was designed specifically to eliminate family travel stress, creating an environment where every age group thrives.

Our multi-bedroom family residences offer generous living rooms, separate en-suite bathrooms, and private enclosed gardens with shallow wading pools. This intentional layout gives everyone their personal haven while making shared family meals joyful and seamless.

The Little Explorers Club engages young minds with educational nature activities supervised by trained specialists. Children discover organic gardening, seashell pottery, and coastal bird watching, giving parents guilt-free hours to unwind.

Dining with diverse palates is effortless with our customized family menus. Combined with morning mangrove boat safaris and certified on-call babysitting, families surrender to true vacation bliss knowing every practical detail is anticipated.

posts.title: Monsoon: Secret Season
posts.excerpt: Green hills, empty beaches and lower rates. The case for travelling in the rain.
body: While summer and winter draw conventional travelers, discerning connoisseurs consider the monsoon between June and September to be our most enchanting secret. When southwest rains arrive, the coastal landscape transforms into a vibrant emerald paradise bursting with raw vitality.

The air carries the intoxicating fragrance of wet red earth and blooming jasmine. Gentle rainfall falls in rhythmic showers interspersed with luminous sunlit clearings that bathe forest foliage in glistening diamonds of dew.

During this tranquil season, the resort takes on a deeply contemplative ambiance. Verandas become cozy retreats to curl up with a classic novel, savoring roasted coastal corn, cinnamon-infused chai, and slow-simmered herbal broths that warm the spirit.

Ayurveda traditionally regards the monsoon as the prime period for detoxification and cell rejuvenation. With uncrowded beaches and lush riverways, a monsoon escape to Suryavana invites you to slow down and reconnect with nature's purest rhythm.

posts.title: Ayurveda & Forest Rituals
posts.excerpt: Ancient holistic healing, herbal botanical infusions, and oceanfront sound bath therapies.
body: Rooted in five thousand years of sacred Vedic wisdom, our wellness philosophy embraces the eternal dance between Surya—the golden solar energy of vitality—and Vana—the nurturing forest canopy of deep peace, inviting guests on a transformative healing journey.

Every wellness residency commences with an in-depth consultation by our resident Ayurvedic physician (Vaidya). Through pulse diagnosis (Nadi Pariksha), your unique Prakriti is identified to tailor customized herbal remedies and nutrition.

Morning rituals begin at dawn in our open-air teak yoga pavilion with guided pranayama breathwork and gentle Surya Namaskar. In our treatment suites, skilled therapists administer authentic Abhyanga warm botanical oil massages that stimulate lymphatic drainage.

For mental serenity, the Shirodhara ritual pours a continuous warm stream of herbalized oil across the forehead chakra, followed by evening Tibetan singing bowl sound therapy that grounds you in lasting inner tranquility.

home.introTitle:
A Sunlit Forest Sanctuary
Where Nature Whispers & Luxury Abides
introText: Suryavana Hotel & Resort is a serene eco-luxury sanctuary nestled between verdant forest hills, ancient groves, and sunlit waters. Inspired by 'Surya' (the divine golden sun) and 'Vana' (the sacred lush forest), our architecture and rituals celebrate the eternal harmony between amber sunbeams and emerald canopies.

Whether unwinding in private timber pool villas, practicing sunrise yoga beneath ancient teak boughs, or savoring organic botanical cuisine, every detail is crafted for unhurried rest and deep rejuvenation.

heritage.title: From Sacred Forest to Sunlit Sanctuary
paragraphs: Suryavana was founded in 2013 on an untouched expanse where ancient teak groves and coconut canopies met golden coastal breezes. Our founders envisioned an eco-haven where the pace of life matched the gentle, restorative rhythm of the forest and the sun.

Today, the resort has blossomed into secluded timber villas, hillside suites, organic dining pavilions, and holistic wellness spaces. Yet the founding ethos remains pure: warm hospitality, honest botanical nourishment, and spaces that let your soul breathe deeply.

items.question: What are the standard check-in and check-out timings?
items.answer: Check-in begins at 14:00 (2:00 PM) and check-out is at 12:00 (noon). Early arrivals and extended departures can be coordinated in advance with our concierge, subject to villa availability.

items.question: Do you provide airport and private boat transfers?
items.answer: Yes. We offer chauffeur-driven luxury vehicle transfers from both regional and international airports. Guests arriving by coastal charter can also disembark directly at our private resort jetty.

items.question: Can custom dietary requirements and vegan dining be accommodated?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our culinary team caters to plant-based, vegan, Jain, gluten-free, and bespoke ayurvedic diets using fresh organic produce harvested daily from our estate orchards.

items.question: What is the cancellation and rescheduling policy?
items.answer: Direct bookings enjoy flexible modification or cancellation up to 7 days prior to arrival without penalty. Our dedicated reservations concierge is available 24/7 to assist with changes.

items.question: Are private wellness and yoga sessions available for beginners?
items.answer: Yes. Our resident masters conduct daily dawn meditation and sunrise yoga suitable for all skill levels, alongside tailored one-on-one wellness consultations and bespoke spa journeys.

philosophy.title: From Surya to Table: Sacred Groves & Ocean Bounty
philosophy.description: At Suryavana, dining is an intimate extension of our sanctuary ethos. Every ingredient honors the sacred balance between Surya—the sun that ripens our estate orchards—and Vana—the rich, fertile forest floor that nurtures our spices and herbs.
paragraphs: We collaborate closely with traditional catamaran fishermen who cast their nets at dawn, bringing pristine snapper, prawns, and crab directly to our shoreline kitchen within hours of catch.
Our botanical gardens provide fragrant lemongrass, curry leaves, turmeric, and black pepper, while our stone flour mill and wood ovens produce rustic breads baked fresh daily at dawn.

venues.description: Perched high above the azure bay, The Cliffside Terrace celebrates the evening transition from radiant sun to twilight stars. Our culinary team presents an artistic seven-course tasting journey that shifts course-by-course as the sun dips below the horizon.

venues.name: Coconut Grove Beach Grill
venues.cuisine: Fresh Catamaran Catch, Charcoal Lobster & Tandoori Aromatics
venues.description: Feel the cool, powdery sands beneath your feet as lanterns flicker in the ocean breeze. Guests choose directly from our iced display of local lobster, kingfish, and tiger prawns, caught at dawn by local fishermen and flame-grilled over seasoned coconut husks.

venues.tagline: Sunrise Elixirs, Tropical Breads & Orchard Bounty
